featured_reviews.name: Saniya Sanghvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Jolly Stationery has been a part of my life since childhood. From school projects and exam supplies to gifting and everyday essentials, this has always been our family's go-to place. The collection is amazing, prices are fair, and the owners are incredibly helpful and welcoming. It's rare to find a store that combines quality, variety, and such warm service. So many memories are attached to this place, and I still prefer coming here over ordering online. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: V_Raj Ambekar
featured_reviews.review_text: We’ve had a wonderful experience with Jolly Stationary and Xerox. They always deliver printouts on time and exactly as per our school requirements. Their service is reliable, efficient, and very convenient. Highly recommended for all printing and stationary needs..!

featured_reviews.name: Keshab Chandra Goswami
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jolly Stationery & Xerox continues to uphold its legacy of excellent customer service under the management of Kalpesh and Sonam. The shop remains a trusted one-stop destination for all stationery needs, always well-stocked to serve the local community efficiently.

They have maintained their expertise in sourcing school books, catering to the requirements of nearby schools and colleges. If a book isn't readily available, they go the extra mile to arrange it within a week.

Their proficiency in ID card printing is remarkable. They were among the first to offer Aadhar and Universal Pass printing, and with their high-quality printers, they handle most customizations seamlessly.

While the shop deeply misses the presence of its empathetic mother, her values of customer care and honesty continue to reflect in the way Kalpesh and Sonam run the business. Their dedication ensures that every visit remains a pleasant experience.
